script.source: GOB 217 uses SetEvadeCombatTimer as StatModTermFunc. The shipped callback calls addRecastTimer on the parent with 30.0 seconds.
script.runtime: AbilityHandler toggles off the existing buff. AbilityBuffs removes the shield and starts the parent ability's own reuse at termination rather than activation.
script.test: The ordinary sequence in StarterEvadeEntryMode and PR524 verifies shield on, shield removal and an 80 bd 01 own 30 s timer immediately after the off event (PacketLog 2695–2696). https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/524

notes.PR526: Stock Lockdown blocks walking and 80 c3 while rooted; the same native Hyper-Jump gesture after expiry produces one echo and a jump. Owner and observer receive +0.45 and bits 0x1400, then +0.45 with 0x1000 after Sprint ends, plus 5 s Sprint reuse. This samples standing movement and root gating; rank-dependent jump geometry and movement in Sneak or invisibility remain open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/526
